mechanisms.name: Inline coupled-line corrections
mechanisms.formula: Temperature interpolation YI/GI is not sign-restricted; SP=SUI*(1+GI*PAVP2), SPPI=SUI*YI*PAVP0, SPPSP=SPPI/SP. Signed ZF*SPPSP terms are added to line profiles. Such terms can decrease opacity and are not disabled by ICNTNM=0.
mechanisms.inference: A concrete active mechanism; actual attribution requires coupling/band localization, not inferred from negative count.

mechanisms.name: Signed interpolation of profile subfunctions
mechanisms.formula: 4-point coefficients include -7/128, -5/128 and -1/16; R3→R2→R1 resampling does not impose positivity.
mechanisms.inference: Can create numerical undershoot near spectral structure; magnitude/cause is not established from source alone.

mechanisms.name: Cross-section cold extrapolation
mechanisms.formula: Below first temperature, first two database temperatures selected; FAC2=(T-T1)/(T2-T1) may be negative and FAC1>1. Weighted spectra are added without a positivity clamp. HCFC22 minimum retained temperature is253 K.
mechanisms.inference: Possible cold-layer contribution. Negatives already exist at T260.8542 in layer1, so HCFC22 below253 extrapolation cannot alone explain all negative values.

mechanisms.name: Fourth-function cutoff/baseline subtraction
mechanisms.formula: F4BND and CO2 fcnt_fn subtractions are present in fourth-function code.
mechanisms.inference: Current ILBLF4=0 bypasses this fourth-function path. Do not attribute current negative OD to that inactive subtraction.

mechanisms.name: Continuum omission
mechanisms.formula: ICNTNM=0 disables continuum/CIA and skips CONTNM. It leaves line/coupling and XS terms active.
mechanisms.inference: Removes potentially positive background contribution; does not prove continuum1 repairs sign or makes either run physical truth.
